assets.prompt: An epic 1980s action movie trailer score in retro synthwave style. Pulsing analog synth bass arpeggios, big gated reverb drums, bright heroic synth brass and a soaring lead synth, electric guitar power chords in the big moments. Clear dynamic arc from a dark quiet intro to a huge climax. Clean, wide, punchy cinematic mix with headroom, no distortion. Instrumental, no vocals.
assets.lyrics:
[Intro — dark analog synth drone, distant thunder, slow rising filter sweep]
[Verse 1 — soft pulsing synth bass arpeggio enters, light ticking hi-hats]
[Verse 2 — gated reverb drums kick in, bass arpeggio grows brighter]
[Build — driving sixteenth-note synth bass, rising snare rolls, tension climbing]
[Breakdown — drums drop out, warm melodic synth lead over shimmering pads]
[Big Hit — massive drum hit and brass stab, then a fast rising riser]
[Chorus — full power: soaring heroic synth lead, pounding gated drums, electric guitar power chords]
[Climax — biggest moment, everything layered, screaming lead, double-time drums]
[Outro — final huge hit, synth chord rings out and fades]

assets.prompt: An epic 1980s Hollywood blockbuster action trailer score, full live symphony orchestra. Bold heroic brass fanfare theme, thundering timpani and snare drum, driving string ostinatos, cymbal crashes and choir in the climax. Clear dynamic arc from a brooding quiet intro to a triumphant finale. Clean, wide, natural concert hall recording with headroom, no distortion. Instrumental, no vocals.
assets.lyrics:
[Intro — low brooding strings and distant timpani rolls, a lone french horn]
[Verse 1 — staccato string ostinato starts, quiet and determined]
[Verse 2 — snare drum march joins, low brass swells underneath]
[Build — rising strings, accelerating timpani, brass crescendos, tension climbing]
[Breakdown — music pulls back to a hopeful horn melody over soft strings]
[Big Hit — enormous orchestral hit with cymbal crash, then a rising string run]
[Chorus — full orchestra: bold heroic brass theme, pounding timpani and snare, soaring strings]
[Climax — the biggest statement of the theme, choir and full brass, thundering percussion]
[Outro — final triumphant chord, timpani roll, ringing out]

assets.prompt: An epic 1980s action movie trailer anthem, arena hard rock. Chugging palm-muted electric guitar riffs, anthemic power chords, a screaming guitar solo, big gated snare drums and bass guitar, heroic synth brass underneath. Clear dynamic arc from a tense quiet intro to an explosive climax. Clean, punchy, well-separated studio mix with headroom, not muddy. Instrumental, no vocals.
assets.lyrics:
[Intro — single palm-muted guitar chug, ominous synth pad, distant thunder]
[Verse 1 — tight palm-muted rhythm guitar riff, kick drum pulse]
[Verse 2 — full drum kit enters with gated snare, bass guitar locks in]
[Build — riff climbs higher, snare rolls, tension rising]
[Breakdown — clean chorus guitar arpeggios over synth pad, drums on toms only]
[Big Hit — huge power chord and crash, then a drum fill]
[Chorus — full power: anthemic distorted power chords, pounding drums, heroic synth brass]
[Climax — screaming guitar solo over the main riff, double-kick drums]
[Outro — final power chord hit, feedback ringing out]
